description: This file defines the configuration class for the Corporate Branding Plugin within the OrangeHRM system. It implements plugin configuration interface, uses a trait for service container functionality, and initializes theme-related services.

classes.name: CorporateBrandingPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the Corporate Branding plugin, particularly registering theme services during initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration by registering the ThemeService into the service container.
